create_GumbelVectorQuantizer: create a GumbelVectorQuantizer module with specified input dimension, number of variables, temperature, and groups for vector quantization
run_forward_GumbelVectorQuantizer: run the forward pass of GumbelVectorQuantizer on input tensor to produce quantized output and perplexity metrics
sample_from_codebook_GumbelVectorQuantiz: sample random vectors from the GumbelVectorQuantizer codebook with specified batch size and sample count
get_codebook_indices_GumbelVectorQuantiz: get the codebook indices tensor from GumbelVectorQuantizer for all variable combinations across groups
set_num_updates_GumbelVectorQuantizer: set the number of training updates in GumbelVectorQuantizer to decay the current temperature value
